domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains to check, e.g. "example.com". Subdomains and URLs work too: "shop.example.co.uk" is checked as "example.co.uk". One lookup is billed per entry. Not all TLDs support RDAP: mainstream gTLDs (.com, .net, .org, .info, .dev, .app, etc.) are well covered; some ccTLDs (e.g. "co", "us") are not.
